gh pr list --repo <owner>/<repo> --state.how: renovate_version.py runs it from part.md: on a repo the hosted Renovate app opens pull requests in (open-telemetry/opentelemetry-js), the version its latest one's renovate-debug footer names (e.g. 44.249.1); on one it never has (octocat/Hello-World), nothing, exit 0. The same lookup inside the validator step falls back to versions.env's pin there

npx --yes --package=renovate@<RENOVATE_V.how: On assets/renovate/.github/renovate.json5: 'Validating ... as repo config', 'Config validated successfully'; without --no-global the same file is 'Validating ... as global config'. Also prints a harmless re2 warning: MODULE_NOT_FOUND (Node 24), ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED (Node 26), then 'falling back to RegExp'. Pinned because @latest once resolved to 44.131.1, which npm can't install (EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL, 'Unsupported URL Type "patch:"' in a dependency); 44.131.0 and 44.130.0 install and run (`renovate --version`)

npx --yes --package=renovate@<version> -.how: Prints the version when that release installs (44.125.1, 44.112.0, 44.131.0); when one doesn't install it exits non-zero with only npm's 'A complete log of this run can be found' line (44.132.0, 44.131.3, 44.131.2, stopping after fetching @renovatebot/osv-offline-db), so the release before it is tried

npm view renovate version.how: Prints the latest published version (44.131.1 when 44.131.1 was the broken release; then 44.131.2). It doesn't say whether the release installs: `npx --yes --package=renovate@<version> -- renovate --version` does (44.131.1: EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL; 44.131.0: prints the version)

npx --package=renovate.how: `npx --yes --package=renovate -- renovate --version` on Node 26.10 gives 37.440.7 (engines '^18.12.0 || >=20.0.0', the last open-ended range; 38.0.0 is '^20.15.1', 44.129.0 '^24.11.0'), on Node 24.13 44.129.0; with renovate@latest both give 44.129.0 (Node 26: EBADENGINE warning only). 37.440.7's validator rejects the asset's renovate.json5 with 'Custom Manager contains disallowed fields: managerFilePatterns' (as a repo's own unversioned validator workflow did in CI), and doesn't know --no-global (it reads it as a file); 44.129.0 on Node 26 validates it

npx --yes --package=renovate@<RENOVATE_V.how: Run from the doc on rendered registry and codegen projects (Node 24.13): exit 0, the report lists every annotated pin, no token needed. The same rendered project with nothing staged extracts 0 pins and with `git add -A` (no commit) all 7: it reads only tracked files. In a repo whose devEngines pin Node ^26.3.0, on Node 26.10: logs 'Unsupported node environment detected' (renovate's engines: node ^24.11.0) and exits 1, but writes the report with the Makefile's SOURCE_REGISTRY and versions.env's WEAVER_VERSION; git status unchanged after it

jq -r '.repositories[].packageFiles.rege.how: Run from the doc on the report above: one '<file> <depName> <currentValue>' line per extracted pin, two per manifest core registry (schema_url, registry_path), e.g. 'versions.env open-telemetry/weaver v0.28.0'
